title: isolepis bergiana

The Dwarf Club Sedge is known to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the Dwarf Club Sedge include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
